Millennium Falcon Lego Set:
The Millennium Falcon is one of the most iconic spaceships in the Star Wars universe, and now you can build your own with this Lego set. The set includes Han Solo, Chewbacca, Rey, Finn, and BB-8 minifigures, as well as a buildable Millennium Falcon ship. The ship features a cockpit that opens to seat the minifigures, rotating top and bottom gun turrets, and a removable top panel to reveal a detailed interior. The set also includes a chicken leg element for Han Solo to hold, adding a touch of humor to the build. This set is a must-have for any Star Wars or Lego fan.

Master Builders:
The Master Builders are a group of Lego minifigures that appear in The Lego Movie and The Lego Movie 2. These minifigures have the unique ability to build anything they can imagine without the need for instructions. They meet in the "Dog" part of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various issues and come up with creative solutions. The Master Builders are a symbol of imagination, creativity, and the power of play.

Establishment of a Website and Premises for the Horizon Compensation Advisory Board (HCAB):
The HCAB is responsible for monitoring individual cases and providing recommendations to the government regarding compensation for those affected by the Horizon IT system failure. In order to fulfill its duties effectively, the HCAB should establish a website and premises. The terms of reference for the HCAB should include the following:

* Understand and acknowledge what went wrong and key lessons that must be learned.
* Obtain all available relevant evidence from the Post Office, Fujitsu, BEIS and other relevant sources.
* Produce written reports in respect of each of their meetings.
* Increase membership to ensure that it has sufficient capacity.
* Seek directions under section 4(2) of the Inquiries Act 2005 within 28 days of its establishment.
